fullAnalysis: At first, this looked more like a wellness board than a candle board.
Aromatherapy pushed me in that direction immediately.
Unscented kept that theory alive for a moment, but it also made the fit feel shaky.
If the set were really about spa or scent products, Votive would still feel too specific.
That was the clue that changed the solve.
The moment I read Votive as a candle type, the earlier clues stopped drifting.
Aromatherapy read cleanly as a scented candle.
Unscented read cleanly as an unscented candle.
Now the set finally felt concrete instead of vague.
The answer was Types of candles.
After that, Citronella fit as the outdoor candle, and Birthday (make a wish!) fit as the most familiar candle in the set.
Once the answer lands, the whole board feels clean in hindsight.
solutionNarrative: Aromatherapy pushed me toward wellness products first, and Unscented kept that theory alive for a moment. It still felt unstable, though, because Votive was too specific to live comfortably inside a vague scent-products read.

The turn came when I read Votive as a candle type instead of as another lifestyle clue. Once that clicked, Aromatherapy and Unscented both resolved cleanly, and Types of candles became the only reading that fit the whole set.
